note: Scenario data transcribed from the TTS scenario cards (deck 552, front = card text, back = I/Sxx) and the Scenario Book pp3-11. Priority when rules disagree: card text > Scenario Book > Rulebook. fx strings use the FX DSL (docs/FX_DSL.md); scenario-specific tokens: scenario:place:<id> (place face up in the Scenario display; a card with `triggers` also places its Scenario Trigger tokens), scenario:resolve:<id> (reveal + resolve now), scenario:remove:<id>, trigger:<round> (place a Scenario Trigger token), expedition:place:<id> (put the card in the Expedition display), exhaustAll:hope, loseHalfFood, scoutsReturnNoReward, victory, defeat. Conditions are strings: beaconBuilt, revealed:<id>, round<=N, round>=N (prefix ! to negate). The engine resolves `triggers` in the Dawn Phase when the Round marker reaches the token's space (token removed first).

start.ruleRef: Rulebook p13-15 setup 'Round track': S01 face up, Scenario Trigger tokens on 4 and 11 (a third token goes on 12 when S04 is placed).

options.text: Let the refugees enter our city.
Send them to look for another place to live.

specialAction.text: Spend Food and/or Coal; place 1 Food Ration marker per 3 Food and 1 Coal Stock marker per 2 Coal. The total number of Stockpile markers on the card may not exceed `slots`.

steps.note: Lose half of your Food, rounded up (Food = Food - ceil(Food/2)).
Return all Scouts from Expeditions without collecting rewards.
Generator Phase as normal (fuel, sickness from cold, stress, breakdown, Heat marker reset).
Hunger +2 for each Citizen Meeple; gain 5 Food per Food Ration marker on S03/S07; you may spend Food to decrease Hunger; resolve the Hunger-marker effect.

Gain 12* sick Citizens of each type (*reduce by 2 for each Coal Stock on S03/S07). All Shelters count as heated (Ruins stay unusable unless a Law says otherwise). Each Citizen Meeple without a warm place to sleep gains 3 sick Citizens of its type. Resolve the Sickness markers.
If you have survived (no lose condition triggered) you are victorious.

expedition.name: Path to Winterhome
expedition.note: Placed white side (route map, 6 steps) up in the Expedition display by S02. It is a normal expedition stack of one card: Scouts advance with Weather/Deploy movement; when the Scout reaches the end the card flips to its text side.

S06.title: Vox Populi
S06.note: Persistent effect while face up: every Dawn Phase. '+1 Discontent' = take 1 Discontent token at random from the bag (type not specified).

S07.title: Prepare for the Storm

specialAction.text: Same as S03 but 6 slots and no Hope penalty when placed.

S07.note: S03 and S07 are mutually exclusive (S05 places S07 only if S03 has not been revealed; S01@11 places S03 only if S07 has not been revealed).

S08.title: Storm
S08.note: Card text decides by Round (the rulebook text says 1st/2nd Storm; the printed card wins). Includes Shelters on the Buildings board. No Event icon => returned face down beside the Weather deck.

S09.title: Storm (Frozen Grove)
S09.note: Numbers are relative advances (same convention as Weather card section A). A removed indicator ceases to exist: its zone and its insulation colour can no longer be heated by the Heat marker (Steam Hubs, Fuel tokens and scenario effects still can). ASSUMPTION: when the second branch resolves without the first having happened (first Storm at Round >= 8) both yellow and orange are removed, matching the printed picture.

crater.name: A New Home: Crater
crater.map: Rulebook p9 setup: random Wall deposits (3 of 7 tokens) and Near/Far tiles on the 3 empty corners. See map.json boards.crater.
crater.win: S04 resolved and still alive (see S04 steps).

start.mapRule: Generator tile attached to the bottom Rim corner; 8 Near tiles face-up as per map.json boards.frozenGrove; 1 random Wall deposit (Wood or Coal) on the top corner.

extraRules.text: A Remove Snow, Gather Resources, Construct or Use a Building action may only be performed on a Map tile that is adjacent to the Generator tile or connected to it by other Map tiles. Heating of tiles/buildings is NOT limited by this.

Steam Hub (S, White insulation, cost 1 Wood, cannot be upgraded, 3 pieces, unlocked by Technology T09 'Steam Hub' cost 3). Passive: at any time during the round, if the Heat marker level is higher than the RED Insulation level (indicator level), you may place 1 Coal from the supply into the Steam Hub; while it holds a Coal the tile it is on and all adjacent tiles count as heated. Return the Coal to the bank at the end of the Generator Phase.

start.note: 8 Steel (wooden components) start in the bank.

extraRules.text: You may place a Meeple on a Dreadnought tile as a 'Use a Building' action to gain 1 Steel. A Dreadnought tile is a Small Building with Blue insulation (only heated if it is in a heated zone).

Steel is a Resource limited to 8 (components). Steel substitutes for Wood in a Build sub-action; mixing Wood and Steel is allowed. If a Building is built by paying its full Wood cost in Steel it is immediately upgraded for free.
